scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof given for all positive chain lengths; finite enumeration serves only as a reproducibility check; unrefined previously published results are credited, not rebranded.
scientific_limitations: For full increasing binary-increment transformations of finite chains, only idempotent centralizers are counted. Constant clamps are indistinguishable by the rank polynomial; reflection is not inner conjugacy in the monoid. The Gaussian statement assumes a uniform ordered commuting pair. The unrefined centralizer cardinalities and unrefined pair total already appear in prior publications. Global historical priority has not been certified, and no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Rank-refined centralizers reconstruct nonconstant directed-path clamps up to reflection
